rows.name: Tellus Magnetic — RTP Tilt Derivative

references.label: OSNI Open Data — Tellus Magnetic Grids

rows.name: Tellus Electromagnetic — 3 kHz Apparent Conductivity

rows.name: Tellus Electromagnetic — 14 kHz Apparent Conductivity

references.label: OSNI Open Data — Tellus Electromagnetic Grids

rows.name: Tellus Radiometric — Potassium (K %)

rows.name: Tellus Radiometric — Uranium-Equivalent (eU ppm)

references.label: OSNI Open Data — Tellus Radiometric Grids

rows.name: Tellus Radiometric — Thorium-Equivalent (eTh ppm)

references.label: OSNI Open Data — Tellus Radiometric Grids

rows.name: Tellus Radiometric — Total Counts (gamma)

rows.name: Tellus Radiometric — K/Th/U Ternary RGB
